sources.title: Dracarys-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct model card
sources.evidence: Current official card names Abacus.AI as developer, identifies this exact model as a coding-oriented fine-tune of Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct, and declares license llama3 with a Llama 3 license link. Its example erroneously names Dracarys-72B-Instruct; the title and explicit base-model statement identify the audited variant.

sources.title: Dracarys checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: LlamaForCausalLM, model_type llama, 80 layers, hidden_size 8192, intermediate_size 28672, 64 attention heads, 8 KV heads, vocab_size 128256, untied embeddings, BF16, and max_position_embeddings 131072. Standard dense Llama configuration has no expert-routing configuration.

sources.title: Dracarys safetensors checkpoint index
sources.evidence: Official checkpoint index contains 723 tensors and total_size 141107412992 bytes, with attention and dense gate/up/down projection tensors for 80 layers; no expert tensors. With the BF16 configuration, this is consistent with 70553706496 scalar parameters.

sources.title: Hugging Face metadata for the Abacus checkpoint
sources.evidence: Current revision is 7e3f4e0d296fd08a944bfad5dcb1ed675c4b38d2; public and ungated. Safetensors metadata reports exactly 70553706496 BF16 parameters. Repository creation timestamp is 2024-08-14T22:27:50Z; creation does not prove initial public visibility.

sources.title: Official Dracarys repository commit history
sources.evidence: Initial commit and tokenizer upload occurred August 14, 2024; Upload LlamaForCausalLM commit 1d6107e73d2b7d23f419dd27b7cc678e4359cebf occurred at 22:45:28Z that day. This is explicit checkpoint-upload evidence, not an explicit public-launch announcement.

sources.title: Meta Llama 3.1 70B Instruct base-model card
sources.evidence: The explicitly identified base is a nominal 70B autoregressive Transformer with text input/output, 128k context, grouped-query attention, and Llama 3.1 Community License. It has tool-use documentation; that alone does not establish retained support in this downstream fine-tune.

sources.title: Dracarys tokenizer configuration
sources.evidence: Simple role/content chat template; no dedicated tools or reasoning switch. model_max_length is 2048, conflicting with the model configuration maximum of 131072. Tokenizer default does not by itself redefine architecture capacity.

sources.title: NVIDIA model-card route for Dracarys
sources.evidence: The route resolved but the retrieved page contained only navigation and footer; it provided no usable technical or capability evidence.

name.note: Display-name punctuation is normalized from the exact official repository title.

developer.note: Developer of this fine-tune; Meta developed its base.

family.note: Llama architecture lineage. Dracarys is the downstream fine-tune series.

release_date.note: Baseline 2024-08-14 matches checkpoint creation/upload. No explicit initial public-release date was established, so do not treat commit date as conclusive launch evidence.

open_weights.note: Public, ungated checkpoint shards and index are available in the developer repository.

license.note: Conflict: downstream card declares Llama 3 Community License, while its explicitly identified Llama 3.1 base declares Llama 3.1 Community License. No separate reconciled license file was established; do not silently resolve the version discrepancy.

parameters_b.note: 70B is the nominal base size, confirmed against this fine-tune configuration and published tensors. Exact tensor count is 70,553,706,496 (70.553706496B); retaining nominal 70 avoids false precision in the catalog.

active_parameters_b.note: Dense checkpoint, with no separately reported active-per-token count. Do not copy the total into this field.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Llama Transformer with grouped-query attention, confirmed in the exact fine-tune configuration and tensor index.

context_window.note: Exact model max_position_embeddings is 131072. Tokenizer model_max_length is only 2048; this is a configuration inconsistency. No independent fine-tune long-context evaluation or provider-serving limit was verified.

modalities.note: Text tokenizer and Llama causal-LM configuration; the explicit base is text-only.

reasoning.note: No explicit dedicated reasoning-mode declaration. Benchmark reasoning performance does not prove a reasoning-mode flag, and lack of such a declaration does not prove false.

tool_call.note: No explicit support or non-support declaration for this exact fine-tune. Base-model tool support cannot automatically be inherited; the shipped chat template does not establish it.

description.value: Abacus.AI coding fine-tune of Llama 3.1 70B Instruct
description.note: Accurately states the documented training lineage and purpose without repeating unsupported benchmark superiority claims.

patch.notes: 70B is nominal; the published BF16 checkpoint contains 70,553,706,496 parameters. Dense model; active parameters are not separately reported. August 14, 2024 is the first checkpoint-upload date, not a verified public-launch date. License conflict: Abacus card declares Llama 3, while its named Llama 3.1 base declares Llama 3.1. Model config allows 131072 positions, but tokenizer model_max_length is 2048. Fine-tune-specific reasoning-mode and tool-call support remain unverified.

summary: Confirmed exact fine-tune identity, nominal 70B size (70.553706496B exact checkpoint count), dense architecture, open weights, text-only I/O, and 131072 configured positions. Upgrade parameter provenance to primary_source. Flag unresolved license-version and tokenizer-length inconsistencies. The existing date matches first upload but is not a verified public launch; reasoning and tool-call negatives are unsupported. Proposed nulls preserve those uncertainties for parent review.
